# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `mise run docs:cli` from src/lib/schemas/cli.ts — do not edit by hand. -->

`granary` needs Bun 1.4.1 or newer. Every command takes `--data <dir>`; without it the data
directory is `GRANARY_DATA_DIR`, else `/var/lib/granary` if it exists, else `$XDG_STATE_HOME/granary`,
else `~/.local/state/granary`. The systemd unit uses `/var/lib/granary`; run commands against it as its
owner: `sudo -u granary granary …`.

Only `init` and `serve` create anything. Every other command refuses (exit 4) a data directory that
is missing, not initialised, or not accessible as the current user, and says which directory it
looked at and why; it never falls back to another one.

Commands that change something talk to the running server over its admin socket
(`<data>/admin.sock`, mode 0600), so the server sees the change at once. When no server is
running, most of them write the database directly instead.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success |
| 1 | the command failed (the message says why) |
| 2 | unknown command or option, missing argument |
| 3 | the command needs the running server and there is none |
| 4 | the data directory is missing, not initialised, or not accessible as this user; nothing was written |

## Commands

### `granary serve`

Run the granary server.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--host <value>` | Bind address (default `0.0.0.0`) |
| `--port <value>` | Port (default `3000`) |

### `granary init`

Create the data dir, generate and confirm the master key, write granary.env. It refuses while the server runs.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--origin <value>` | Public URL, e.g. https://granary.example.com |
| `--yes-i-stored-the-key` | Skip the interactive key confirmation |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary doctor`

Check Bun, data dir, master key, databases, disk, ORIGIN and GitHub. It uses the running server when there is one, else writes the database directly.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary admin add <login>`

Make a GitHub login an admin. It uses the running server when there is one, else writes the database directly.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary admin remove <login>`

Remove an admin (not the last one). It uses the running server when there is one, else writes the database directly.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary admin list`

List admins. It uses the running server when there is one, else writes the database directly.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary blocklist add <login>`

Block a GitHub login: their issues are closed, even if allowlisted or an owner (ADR 0260). It uses the running server when there is one, else writes the database directly.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |
| `--for <value>` | Block only for this long, e.g. 1h, 30m, 7d (default: until removed) |
| `--note <value>` | Why (shown in the UI) |

### `granary blocklist remove <login>`

Unblock a GitHub login. It uses the running server when there is one, else writes the database directly.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary blocklist list`

List blocked logins (expired entries marked). It uses the running server when there is one, else writes the database directly.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary login-link <login>`

Print a one-time sign-in URL for an admin. It uses the running server when there is one, else writes the database directly.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |
| `--ttl <value>` | Validity, e.g. 15m, 2h (max 24h) (default `15m`) |

### `granary github status`

Show the GitHub connection, installations and catch-up. It needs the running server (admin socket).

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary github setup-url`

Print the URL of the GitHub setup page. It needs the running server (admin socket).

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |
| `--login <value>` | Also create a login link for this admin |

### `granary config get <key>`

Read an in-product setting (dotted key). It uses the running server when there is one, else writes the database directly.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary config set <key> <value>`

Write an in-product setting (dotted key, JSON or string value). It uses the running server when there is one, else writes the database directly.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary config seed`

Apply env seeds now (never overwrites edited values). It uses the running server when there is one, else writes the database directly.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary backup now`

Run a backup plan now. It needs the running server (admin socket).

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |
| `--plan <value>` | Plan id (default: all enabled plans) |

### `granary backup list`

List recent backup runs. It needs the running server (admin socket).

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |

### `granary restore`

Restore a backup (see `granary restore --help`, ADR 0115). It refuses while the server runs.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |

### `granary systemd-unit`

Print a systemd unit for granary. It talks to neither the server nor the database.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--user <value>` | Service user (default `granary`) |
| `--bin <value>` | Path to the granary binary |

### `granary version`

Print granary, Bun and tinyactors versions. It talks to neither the server nor the database.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--data <value>` | Data directory (else GRANARY_DATA_DIR, /var/lib/granary if it exists, $XDG_STATE_HOME/granary, ~/.local/state/granary) |
| `--json` | Print the raw JSON result |
